locations.story_use: The design treatment happens here: the team lays the ferry out as a strip of paper with card benches and slides the card helm cabin into place.
locations.name: The studio
locations.description: A design studio where new designs are worked out on paper and card before any steel is cut.
locations.layout: One long room with a single long table down its middle and a clear walkway around it on every side. Tall windows run along one long wall and a pinboard covers the wall opposite them.
fixed_features: a long work table down the middle of the room
a pinboard covering the wall opposite the windows
light_sources: tall windows along one long wall
a row of pendant lamps over the table

locations.story_use: The construction treatment happens here: the framing for both ends is set out from one template, the sides rise as posts and openings, and the roof goes on.
locations.name: The building hall
locations.description: A covered yard hall built for framing and roofing large vessels under cover.
locations.layout: One tall, long covered hall with a level concrete floor. A large door fills one gable end, staging towers stand along both long walls, and crane rails run the length of the hall overhead.
fixed_features: a line of building blocks along the floor
staging towers along both long walls
an overhead crane on rails running the length of the hall
light_sources: a band of roof lights along the ridge
floodlights fixed to the staging towers

locations.story_use: Finishing, completion and the crossing happen here: the gates are hung and the benches fixed, the operators test both sides, and the passengers ride across the harbour.

connections.via: the quay's gangway, while the ferry lies port side to the fitting-out berth
the boarding edge of the home pier, while the ferry lies port side to it
the boarding edge of the far pier, while the ferry lies port side to it

locations.story_use: The ferry lies here through finishing and completion, and in completion the operators step out through an opening onto the quay and back aboard.
locations.name: The fitting-out quay
locations.description: A working quay with a deep berth where vessels lie alongside to be fitted out and tested.
locations.layout: A long straight quay edge beside a deep berth, with an open paved apron behind it and a gangway landing at mid-length.

connections.via: the gangway landing, while the ferry lies port side to the berth

fixed_features: a hoist standing on the apron
light_sources: floodlight masts along the back of the apron

locations.story_use: The operation treatment happens here: the gates open along the pier side and the waiting crowd steps aboard across the width.
locations.name: The home pier
locations.description: The public pier on the home side of the harbour.
locations.layout: A long boarding edge along the water, with a roofed waiting area set back from the edge and an open walk between them.

connections.via: the boarding edge, while the ferry lies port side to the pier

fixed_features: a long boarding edge along the water
a roofed waiting area set back from the edge
light_sources: lamp posts along the boarding edge

locations.story_use: The ending happens here: the ferry comes alongside and the passengers wait at the closed gates for the side to open.
locations.name: The far pier
locations.description: The pier across the harbour, where the crossing ends.
locations.layout: A boarding edge along the water across the harbour from the home pier, with its own roofed waiting area set back from the edge.

connections.via: the boarding edge, while the ferry lies port side to the pier

fixed_features: a boarding edge along the water
a roofed waiting area set back from the edge
light_sources: lamp posts along the boarding edge
